  1. Roblox: The first and the most exciting game that you must consider playing has to be Roblox. This platform remains a massive hit, allowing users to create and play a wide variety of games. Its continued presence at the top shows its enduring appeal.
  2. Block Blast!: Another popular name that you must consider having installed in your mobile phone without a doubt. This puzzle game has quickly gained traction, offering simple yet addictive gameplay.
  3. Free Fire x NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: If you are still looking for the top name, then you can consider this game and feel the excitement. A collaboration between the popular battle royale game and the well-known anime series, this title has attracted a significant number of downloads.
  4. Subway Surfers: It is one of the oldest games that is still a big popular name and you must experience this without a miss. It is certainly an oldie but goodie, this endless runner continues to be a favorite, thanks to its simple mechanics and regular updates.
  5. Mini Games: The last and the most crazy game for you to consider is Mini games that are perfect for on-the-go gaming. This collection of mini-games doesn’t require Wi-Fi, making it ideal for travel.

FAQs

What is the most downloaded Android game?

So, when we talk about the most downloaded game on Android, Subway Surfers usually comes up. It’s been downloaded over 2.05 billion times since it came out, which is pretty massive!

What is the most downloaded iOS game?

On iOS Block Blast! has recently on the top of the most downloaded iOS games in 2024 and early 2025. Historically, Subway Surfers and Roblox have also been very popular on iOS.
